latency_model: Reuse only the original 192/640 training calibration, bind its original bytes, and interpolate to the new 448 dimension before final measurements. No 384 or 448 final outcome enters a forecast.
controller_price: For each environment and remaining depth, measure all three planners on the same training observations obtained under a greedy behavior policy. Freeze each planner's median whole decision wall, including its real native framing/validation when applicable. Retain every trial and startup/close; never revise prices from final timings.
price_scope: One retained native session is used for training. Its median is predominantly a warm-process decision forecast, not a cold-start or cleanup cost guarantee. Final episode walls include every cold start, initialization and cleanup; forecasts are never substituted for those actual costs.
greedy_future_price: The gate receives the maximum of the frozen greedy medians over all remaining depths, so its constant future-fee envelope covers the entire remaining registered training price table. This is still a forecast model, not a bound on realized timing.
compute_gate: An O(horizon times actions) conservative model opportunity bound is compared to the frozen predicted current planning price. Candidate action values use the same registered task utility units. Forecast cost is not a guarantee of future physical elapsed time. The same gate and calibration procedure is offered to ordinary same-objective planning and NDU.
paired_order: Rotate and reverse five arms per environment, seed and repetition; all 120 cells and 360 requests remain in the denominator.
qualification: Check executed cache actions, complete delivery, observed whole cost, actual number of skipped native calls, and post-execution model oracle regret. A compute-cost saving is not NDU-exclusive task quality or a proof of model optimality under physical uncertainty.
prior_result: The original 288-cell cohort and its zero numeric-preference variation / no-net-gain result remain unchanged. This is a separate prospectively frozen computation-price qualification with fresh final inputs.
